generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in the form of NSC/DD/FDR in the name of The COMMISSIONER, MUDA, mYSORE given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the Conditions of Contract.

Regarding Appealing Aggrieved contractors may appeal to the prescribed (Appellant) authority within 15 days as per KTTP and appeal should be through e-proc only as per Govt.order No:pwd/572/CRM-2020(E) Bangalore DT.09-10-2020. The same will not be considered if appeal through Letters.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class IV & Above Registration.
Assessed Tender Capacity shall be more than the Tendered Amount Rs.19.91 Lakhs.
GST at 18% shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for the delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.

The tenderer who quotes amount less than amount put to tender should pay difference amount in the form of FDR purchased through any nationalized bank payable at MYSORE only in favor The COMMISSIONER, MUDA at the time of execution of agreement.
The work has to be completed within 60Days from the date of agreement.

The tenderer shall furnish last five years financial turnover, profit and loss account statement i.e., from 2018-19, 2019-20,2020-21, 2021-22 & 2022-23from the authorized Auditor or C.A. (Achieved in at least one financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) (usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this conctract))
